svg.title: Sequence 5 — Session refresh: rotation with reuse detection

g.text: Sequence 5 — Session refresh: rotation with reuse detection
[rotated more than 10 s ago (a copy is being replayed)]
401 session_expired — thief and user must both sign in
[rotated within 10 s (two tabs refreshed at once)]
a revoked role drops out of the new token)
UPDATE RefreshTokens SET RevokedAt = now, RevokedReason = 'Rotated'
WHERE Id = @id AND RevokedAt IS NULL
[request also showed its access token (same user)]
carry the step-up grant to the new access token
Every dead session gets the same 401 answer,
so a replayed copy learns nothing about why it failed.
